title: Title case words
statementMd:
Capitalise the first letter of each space-separated word and lowercase the rest. Keep the spaces.

**Example:** `capitalize_words("hello wORLD")` returns `"Hello World"`.
hints: Split on a single space to keep spacing.
referenceSolution:
def capitalize_words(s):
    return ' '.join(w[:1].upper() + w[1:].lower() for w in s.split(' '))
